question: National Film Award for Best Choreography for the movie Vishwaroopam was awarded to ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandit Birju Maharaj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Birju Maharaj:-**

 
 
• **He was an Indian dancer, composer, singer, and exponent of the Lucknow "Kalka-Bindadin" Gharana of Kathak dance in India.**
 
• He was a descendant of the Maharaj family of Kathak dancers, which includes his two uncles, Shambhu Maharaj and Lachhu Maharaj, and his father and guru, Acchan Maharaj.
 
• He also practised Hindustani classical music and was a vocalist.
 
• **The National Film Award for Best Choreography for the movie Vishwaroopam was awarded to Pandit Birju Maharaj. **
 
• **He was awarded for the song "Unnai Kaanadhu Naan" from the Tamil version of the film.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **M.R. Krishnamurthy:-**

 
 
• **He was an Indian actor and stage artist who appeared in Tamil films. **
 
• He starred in more than 100 films and in more than 500 stage plays conceived and hosted by various leading stage artistes.
 
 
 
• **Amala Akkineni:-**
 
 
• **She is an Indian actress, Bharatanatyam dancer, and animal welfare activist. **
 
• She was a leading actress in the Tamil film industry from 1986 to 1992 and has appeared in many blockbusters in Tamil and other languages.
 
• She has won two Filmfare Awards South, namely Best Actress – Malayalam for the 1991 film Ulladakkam and Best Supporting Actress – Telugu for the 2012 film Life Is Beautiful.
 
 
 
• **Kalamandalam Gopi:-**
 
 
• **He is an Indian dancer who is an exponent of the classical dance-drama style known as Kathakali. **
 
• He was born on May 21, 1937, in Kothachira, Kerala, India.
 
• He completed his formal lessons in the dance from the Kerala Kalamandalam in 1957.
